description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (? each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Wedge]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Wedge
description.text: Increases [Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Wedge after using a Thief ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Trickster+
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, removes negative effects from all allies every four uses

description.name: Star Drive+
description.text: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (1.10 or 3.60 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Wedge
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to the user/party if there are 0-2/3 Thief members in the party, and Six single hybrid attacks (0.6/1.5 each) and grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies if there are 4+ Thief members in the party

description.name: Spirit Attack: Wedge II
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1], [Wind, Poison Ability +30% Boost 1].

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
